template.name: EM VOL
template.notes: The pivot is the previous bar high/low with a one-ATR buffer, and trading is allowed only in the low-volatility regime; AtrPeriod 14, AdxPeriod 14 and the ADX ceiling of 20 are explicit fallbacks because only parameter names are supplied. TakeProfit, StopLoss, TrailStart and TrailStep are price-step distances that are not expressible, so the mirrored support break is used as the long exit.
